[!cgo] skip
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=1
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosfastcgo
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd deny
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/fastdeny$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_cgo\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/fcdep'' reaches ''runtime\.cgocall'''
stderr 'example\.com/fcdep\.Ping\(\)'
stderr 'example\.com/fcdep\._Cfunc_fortytwo\(\)'
cd ..

cd allow
logos build -o $WORK/bin/fastallow$GOEXE ./cmd
! stderr 'capabilities'
go tool nm $WORK/bin/fastallow$GOEXE
stdout 'runtime\.logosCgocallFast'
exec $WORK/bin/fastallow$GOEXE
stdout '^42$'
cd ..

-- deny/go.mod --
module example.com/fcdeny

go 1.27

require example.com/fcdep v0.0.0

replace example.com/fcdep => ../dep

-- deny/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_net = "allow"
transitive_reflect = "allow"
transitive_unsafe_allowlist = ["example.com/fcdep/**"]

-- deny/cmd/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/fcdep"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(fcdep.Ping())
}

-- dep/go.mod --
module example.com/fcdep

go 1.27

-- dep/dep.lgo --
package fcdep

/*
//logos:cgo_fastcall fortytwo
int fortytwo() { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

//go:noinline
func Ping() int {
	return int(C.fortytwo())
}

-- allow/go.mod --
module example.com/fcallow

go 1.27

require example.com/fcdep v0.0.0

replace example.com/fcdep => ../dep

-- allow/logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "allow"

[capabilities]
transitive_net = "allow"
transitive_reflect = "allow"
transitive_unsafe_allowlist = ["example.com/fcdep/**"]

-- allow/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/fcdep"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(fcdep.Ping())
}
